title: Enforcement Rules of the Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax Act
full_text:
■ Enforcement Rules of the Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax Act [Attached Form No. 6] Applications may also be filed through Hometax (www.hometax.go.kr). Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax Release [Without Payment of Tax / under Conditional Tax Exemption] [Approval / Application for Approval / Notice] ※ Check the applicable box. To the Head of the Tax Office / Customs Office
Required documents: See reverse. Fee: None. 210 mm × 297 mm [White paper, 80 g/m², or medium-grade paper, 80 g/m²] (Reverse) Documents to Be Submitted by the Applicant 1. For conditional exemption under Article 15 (1) 1 or 3 of the Traffic, Energy and Environment Tax Act: One copy of a document issued by the head of the competent ministry certifying the relevant facts. 2. For conditional exemption under Article 15 (1) 2 of that Act: One copy of the documents required for an application for exemption under the Customs Act. 3. For conditional exemption of articles for government use: One copy of a document issued by the head of the institution seeking exemption certifying the relevant facts. Fee: None. Matters to Be Verified by the Responsible Public Official For release without payment of tax: Certificate of business registration (applicable only to a business operator; the resident registration number is excluded). Consent to Joint Use of Administrative Information I consent to the responsible public official verifying the matters listed above through joint use of administrative information under Article 36 of the Electronic Government Act in connection with processing this matter. * If consent is not given, the applicant must submit the relevant documents directly. Applicant: ____________________ (Signature or seal) Instructions for Completion 1. Complete the ① resident (alien) registration number field only for an individual who is not a business operator. Processing Procedure This report is processed as follows.
ApplicantProcessing authority: Head of the tax office / customs office having jurisdiction over the place of business
1. Apply2. Receive application (Civil Service Office)
3. Verify (Department responsible for tax-base management)
4. Prepare approval and notice (Department responsible for tax-base management)
5. Dispatch (notice of approval)
Processing arrows: 1 → 2 → 3 → 4 → 5.

metadata.author_method: Exact held-source units translated or completed using explicitly recorded source/target spans; original official records remain unchanged. All new units are MACHINE_TRANSLATION and UNREVIEWED.

visual_reconciliation_overlay.translated_annotation: Both acquired pages retain two ten-column blank article rows and the five specifically named proof documents. The two original seal fields in the approval and notice halves are rendered as Seal; the frozen XML has question marks there. The reverse retains three required-document categories of one copy each, the resident-registration-number exclusion, consent and refusal consequence, and five process boxes connected by exactly four arrows, without an invented return arrow.
